title: Cleaning Service Launch Planner
changes: Adds eight-stage cleaning service launch progression linked to existing opportunity intelligence.
Computes automatic coverage gates from known Marketplace/Workforce readiness only.
Requires explicit manual confirmation for service-specific training/compliance, pilot, quote/scope, delivery standard and first-job completion gates.
Adds target launch date, launch notes, blockers, first-job reference and completion state.
Exports advisory plan status with grants_authority:false, publishes_service:false and executes_work:false.
